no_tempo_analyzer.title: AX BPM: no local tempo analyzer available
no_tempo_analyzer.description:
AX BPM is tracking {entry_title}. Deezer metadata covers most tracks, but tracks where Deezer reports bpm: 0 need local audio analysis. Neither the aubio Python package nor an external aubio binary is available, so those tracks will resolve to unknown.

To fix: install the aubio package in the Home Assistant environment (e.g. `pip install aubio`), or set the "Path to external aubio binary" option in the AX BPM integration settings to an installed aubio CLI binary.

user.title: AX BPM Configuration
user.description: Track the tempo (BPM) of the currently playing media. All network requests are anonymous — no API key required. {mood_warning}
